notes.title: 1 YEAR OF 7 DAYS
notes.notes:
Hello 7-dayers!

(I'm a little late to posting this on Steam, but...)

[h1]THANKS FOR ONE YEAR OF 7 DAYS![/h1]

It's been a full year since I started development of 7 Days. What started as a silly idea in my head, has now turned into my passion project. It's incredible to see how big this game has gotten over the past year and to see how many people care for this lil thing ! I'm truly grateful for all your support and interest !

I'm still working on day 6, but here's something interesting:

As preparation for Next Fest in June, I've updated the demo for 7 Days!
This adds and fixes a couple things:

[list]
[*] Fixed multiple grammar/spelling mistakes
[*] Updated Player Sprites
[*] Added new title screen and music
[*] Updated save/load screen
[*] Updated credits
[*] Added Discord Rich Presence
[*] The game changes the window name based on how much you progressed in game
[*] Fixed Day 2 ending (if you did the "bad" route, it would use the dialogue for the good one)
[*] Updated Poem Cutscene and music in Day 2
[*] Updated Your Room music
[*] Added collectibles (Lost photos and MP3)
[*] Added Xbox and Playstation Controller Support
[*] The ramen noodles look like ramen noodles now
[*] Switched credits and exit game button place on main menu
[*] Changed music in Day 2 flashbacks (Do You Remember?)
[*] Added hole cutscene in Day 2
[*] Removed "lore" from library in Day 2
[*] Reduced intro cutscenes
[*] Removed abillity to skip, this would break some cutscenes if the player held Z
[*] Added the ability to play the K-pop cd on the boombox, instead of asking Aria for permission
[/list]


These have been updates I've been making over the past year, but now they're included in the demo aswell! Now the demo is the best it'll be, just in time for Next Fest!
Thanks for reading, and keep on 7-daying.

Daver The Dave

notes.title: Day 5 is finished!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello 7-dayers![/h1][/b]
[h2]
Day 5 is finished and ready to be playtested![/h2]

This day focuses on the main character's biggest struggles, his relationship with Haven.
Throughout the game, she’s been your save point and emotional support, but now you’ll finally uncover their history together.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216585/7017b3b60fbfeb198b90f9b9a35a7cb4a5e7d14d.gif[/img]
You finally climb Her Mountain, the one you can see from the start of the game.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216585/fda0b00eee29459ac53f25957828cff738f04520.gif[/img]
As you climb, you explore different memories you guys had together. From the good times, to the not-so good times. Also, as you can, see the main character has a new sprite! I felt like the old one didn’t quite capture his look (especially the hair), so I gave him a small makeover.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216585/6f8cf2a0d31978e027ce1e70ab7007f4bd27d497.gif[/img]
I've also added a MP3 Player you can equip in Day 3! With this, you can play songs you find around the game as collectibles! There's 6 to collect in total, with two being original songs by the great [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSGXFkjFaYVaw5ZTJaNpLNg]Joe Kenyon[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@RollyAbore]Three Lices and A Molly![/url] Additionally, I've also completed the lost photos collectibles! They have a bit of extra info about the day's topic, telling the player more about the main character.

That's it for now! Thank you for your support and patience :)

Daver OUT

notes.title: WE HIT 1000 WISHLISTS!
notes.notes:
Dear everyone

WE REACHED 1000 WISHLISTS FOR 7 DAYS!

I'm honestly surprised we got so many already, I didn't expect much out of this lil RPG Maker game and this shows that there are people who are genuinely interested in games like this! I want to thank everyone who pressed the lil button, you're supporting this project a lot!

Work on Day 5 has started, so I'll update you guys with that soon!

notes.title: Day 3 is done!
notes.notes:
[h1][h2]Hello 7-dayers![/h2][/h1]

[h3]Day 3 is finished and ready to be playtested![/h3]
This day is centered around the main character's childhood home and parents. It's more story focused rather than gameplay (let's be fair, there's not much gameplay to be talked about in the entire game) and has some scenes that I've put my best effort in to try and capture those moments. 
Let me show you some visuals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216585/bfffd38a56a9254b5761561f6bcf02aab95a8d05.gif[/img]

Doesn't this just scream nostalgic?
The music in this are should be made by an one and only Rolly Abore, who has made some beautiful music in the past, like his EP '[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ix-6vG3qXPc]maybe we'll hug each other in a past life[/url]' . I reached out to him and he's willing to make two tracks for the game! It's not in the playtest yet, but hopefully we'll get to hear something soon :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216585/7e9dcb2af6fcd6770b0abef5096947ca3807cd87.gif[/img]

Your childhood home, broken down and left to rot.
You revisit some traumatising memories you wish you'd forgotten, but maybe you'll learn something from it.


For the rest, we have a new title screen!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216585/728fa9a9b417c191bebda7319bd553b473501885.gif[/img]

This changes depending on how far your progress is in the game! A big thanks to Sang Hendrix for modifying his Title screen plugin to allow for this to work!

With Day 3 being done, this means that the game is 4/7 done!
I'll be working hard to get it available in its best form, as soon as possible :)

Daver out
*mic drop*
